metadata.attribution: CShapes by Schvitz, Rüegger, Girardin, Cederman, Weidmann, and Gleditsch (2022), ETH Zürich. Display derivative by World History Atlas.

simplification.algorithm: Ramer–Douglas–Peucker, per ring, closed-ring two-arc split
simplification.note: Display generalization only. Not a topology-preserving survey; small gaps/slivers at shared boundaries can result.

limitations: Source de jure conventions differ from maps of military control.
Source names include aliases reused across periods; selected annual label corrections are separate.
Political status metadata is absent in the supplied GeoJSON; no feature is automatically classified as an independent state.
Source period starts may denote geometry changes or capital changes, not state founding.

note.en: Display is selected from exact country-period dates at 31 December of the chosen year; this is a source-coded de jure boundary unit, which may be a state or dependency.
note.zh: 按所选年份12月31日在来源的精确国家时段中选择；这是来源按法理规则编码的边界单元，可能是国家或属地。

note.en: CShapes records international political units, including dependencies, using its own de jure coding conventions. It does not reproduce all wartime occupations, fronts, disputed claims or small territorial changes. Source labels can be modern aliases; the atlas supplies reviewed annual labels for selected transitions.
note.zh: CShapes依据自身法理编码规则记录国际政治单元（包括属地），不复原所有战争占领区、战线、争议主张或小规模领土变动。来源名称可能使用现代别名；本图对部分转折提供逐年名称。
